key_terms.الْوُضُوءُ: Ablution (ritual washing of specific body parts)
key_terms.بِدْعَةٌ: Innovation (a religious practice not established by the Prophet or Imams)

ai.seo_question: Is it necessary to perform wudu after ghusl according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) declares that performing wudu after ghusl is a bid'ah (innovation), indicating that the two are distinct ritual purifications rather than cumulative requirements. This hadith is foundational in Shia fiqh for establishing that ghusl, when performed with the intention of removing major impurity (janabah), suffices for prayer without the need for a subsequent wudu, unless specific conditions like breaking the ghusl or mixing intentions arise.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Shazaan Bin Al Khaleel, from Yunus, from Yahya Bin Talha, from his brother, 
(It has been narrated) from Abdullah Bin Suleyman who said, ‘
I hear Abu Abdullahasws saying: ‘The Ablution (Wudhu) after the washing is an innovation’.
en.sarwar: 12. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Shadhan ibn al-Khalil from Yunus from Yahya ibn Talhah from his father from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sulayman who has said the following: “
I heard abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, say, ‘Wudu’ after Ghusl (bath) is heresy.’”
